title: Code-unit order is equated with the C collation without limiting it to ASCII identifiers, where the two orders differ for other text
resolution: The delta and design D7 say that code-unit order equals the C collation for ASCII identifiers; the normative order stays code-unit order.

title: The design claims the window length bounds the error of a late usage report, although relay delay is unbounded and a stale report gets a new end
resolution: The risk describes the derived window as an approximate validity after application; the length bounds only later use, not report age or deviation from the provider window.

title: The record says the reset signal grep finds one line, but it also matches the G3 plan and two qualification records
resolution: The record lists the four matches and why the plan row and the qualification records stay unchanged.
